info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Update Banking Business Direction Product Strategy By Product Strategy Id-v5-spec
info.description: This API provides functionality to modify existing banking business direction strategies by their unique identifiers. By utilizing this endpoint, financial institutions can enhance their product strategies to better align with market demands and customer needs. Typical consumers of this API include banking organizations and business analysts seeking to update strategy details or react to changing market conditions. This operation supports the agile adjustment of business direction, ensuring that product offerings remain relevant and effective.

patch.description: This API endpoint allows for the updating of the product strategy associated with the specified PROD-700045 identifier. It enables users to modify existing strategy details as needed.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the product strategy for the specified business direction. It allows for partial updates to the resource and requires a payload in JSON format that conforms to the defined schema.
